# Test 20261016-185314-6170: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10, app.py:60, RULES.md:5 | `refund` got `{"order": "5120", "amount_eur": 80}` and returned `"status": "paid"`. RULES.md:5 says "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The app paid it at once with no approval. The cause is in the code: app.py:60 checks `args["amount_eur"] > APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS`, which compares euros to `5000` cents (app.py:28). So only refunds above €5000 wait for a manager. state.json agrees: order 5120 has `"refunds": [{"refund": "RF-4DCA74", "amount_eur": 80}]` and there is no `approvals` list. |
| unsupported_reply | 2 | trace.jsonl:13 | The reply says "you should see it within 3-5 business days." No tool result and no rule gives a payout time. The `refund` result (trace.jsonl:10) only has `{"refund": "RF-4DCA74", "amount_eur": 80, "status": "paid"}`. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17 | The reply says again, with no tool call, that the €80 "will appear in your account within 3-5 business days". Nothing in the records supports this time. Also, "your refund is complete" only holds because of the bug above: under RULES.md:5 the refund should still be waiting for a manager. |

## Notes

- Seal: intact. Audit: no break, 3 turns, 3 exchanges, no blocked calls. findings.json: no findings, all counts are 0.
- There is no `app-state/` folder. I read the project's `state.json` (read-only). It shows the €80 refund RF-4DCA74 paid on order 5120 and no approval request, which matches trace.jsonl:10.
- Turn 1 is correct: `lookup_order` was called with order `5120`, and the reply matches the result (trace.jsonl:3, :6).
- Rule 2 (a damaged item gets a full refund): a full €80 refund was the right amount. Rule 1 (30-day return window): the order data has no delivery date, so I could not check whether the window still applied. I did not report this.
- Rule 4 (other customers' orders): the app did not share order 4471, so it was not broken.
- The model ran through the app's tools as expected (`shop.lookup_order`, `shop.refund`), and every tool result was a success.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

I found 3 issues in test 20261016-185314-6170. The seal is intact and the audit shows no break.
- **Business rule broken (turn 2):** the €80 refund was paid at once, with no manager approval. The rules require approval for any refund above €50. The cause is in `app.py:60`: it compares the amount in euros against `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS` (5000), so only refunds above €5000 wait for a manager. `state.json` agrees: refund RF-4DCA74 is paid and there is no approval request.
- **Unsupported reply (turns 2 and 3):** the agent said the money would arrive "within 3-5 business days." No tool result or rule supports that.
- Turn 1 was correct. I couldn't check the 30-day return rule because the order data has no delivery date, and you wrote no notes.
